'''Rabbit stew''' is the vanilla food. [[Matcha Flavoured]] blocks the two vanilla recipes that use a brown or a red [[mushroom]], so it can only be crafted with a shelf mushroom.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> It is unrelated to [[Ramen]], although both use the rabbit stew item.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
''Minecraft'' 26.3 adds a third rabbit stew recipe, which uses a shelf mushroom, and the pack does not block it. Rabbit stew is crafted from a baked potato, [[Cooked Flesh|cooked flesh]] (the renamed cooked rabbit), a bowl, a carrot and a shelf mushroom, in any arrangement.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> A shelf mushroom drops from a shelf mushroom block, which grows on trees in swamps and dappled forests.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/worldgen/feature/swamp_oak.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/feature/red_poplar.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
The pack gives plain rabbit stew no healing of its own, unlike the foods it makes, and it has no effect.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.6-alpha|2=The shelf mushroom recipe from ''Minecraft'' 26.3 makes rabbit stew available again; the older rabbit stew recipes remain blocked (first in the 1.12.3 alpha for 26.3).}}
